summary: Retain study-specific per-frame controller results and next states; present those results instead of advancing the same state again.
rationale: Flocking and creatures retain every actor reading and the next actor snapshot. Layout, arrows, links, worked arithmetic and notes consume those same readings; a worked example no longer advances an entire group just to take its first member.

Pipeline and the analogous state-stepping studies keep state/calculation/next samples. State-only public frame helpers remain adapters. Presenters and comparisons consume retained calculations; run-wide flock minimum gap is computed once.

Coordinated movement retains follower accelerations and camera readout from the committed formation step. Roster samples retain member advancement. Jump samples retain run-up output, and their fixed planned arc is assembled once.
Iterative targeting retains the first unrounded flight step, including when an impact point is interpolated. Its existing state-only flight API still returns the original fields.
Projectile sampling reuses a landing solution, firing comparisons reuse their admitted solution, and slot frames reuse the already solved optimum.
The heavier-weight arbitration comparison reweights retained raw requests. That necessary counterfactual does not repeat seeking or advance the priority state.

audit.boundary: Static producer/consumer audit of all 40 movement presentation modules and their simulation imports/call sites; followed stepping, controller-reading and solved-result helpers rather than relying only on calculate-prefixed names. Presentation-only scalar metrics and drawing coordinate arithmetic are outside this advancing/controller reuse finding.
audit.compatibility: Preserved existing state-only simulation helper names and arguments through adapters; kept the standalone creature note API. Translation messages, record JSON and machine inputs were not edited.

cases: Flock snapshot continuity, known first reading/velocity, matching worked text, and no presentation calls to readFlock or stepFlock after samples are supplied.
Pipeline accepted/rejected attempts share the committed next state, render their clearance, and are not recalculated through the presentation import.
Creature snapshot continuity and prescribed wander angle survive retention; worked velocity uses the retained next state without readCreature/stepCreatures presentation calls.

validation.staticWork: Read current target rules and F2 report, inspected producer/consumer source, formatted edited TypeScript, and inspected local function call arity, retained-sample scope references and the 80-line source ceiling during authoring. No product code was executed.
validation.requiredParentValidation: Run the integrated TypeScript/lint checks, movement/Tools suite, and retained English/numeric output comparison. The new regression spec has not run under this worker instruction.

limits: Runtime, type, English-output and numerical preservation remain unverified until the parent runs its serialized integrated checks. Retention adds bounded per-run sample objects for the displayed horizon.
source: Native movement worker returned manifest; parent verified all source hashes before integration.
